key_insight: Combining mammograms and radiology reports improved biopsy-outcome discrimination over either modality alone, with a test AUC of 0.72.
clinical_relevance: The approach could help identify benign findings among patients recommended for biopsy, particularly BI-RADS 4–5, but clinical benefit remains unproven.
method: Vision Transformer extracted features from four mammography views per patient.
DeBERTa-V3-Large encoded radiology reports; late fusion combined image and text features.
Grad-CAM highlighted image regions influencing predictions.
evidence_signal: An in-house dataset included 1,632 patients; test AUCs were 0.72 for multimodal, 0.66 for image-only, and 0.68 for text-only models, with 18% specificity at 99% sensitivity.
watch_item: External validation and prospective safety evaluation are needed before using predictions to defer biopsies.
paper_title: Explainable Multimodal AI Approach to Reduce Unnecessary Breast Biopsies
